gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 18.1m was experienced in 2017 (2016: GBP 8.6m deficit). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 22.5m on direct business (2016: GBP 14.1m deficit) and a GBP 4.4m deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2016: GBP 5.5m surplus).
gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a prior year reserve release of GBP 18.1 million in 2017, primarily driven by a GBP 22.5 million surplus on direct business claims provisions. This was partially offset by a GBP 4.4 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business. The release represents a 6.57% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. The syndicate ceased underwriting beyond the 2017 underwriting year and is in run-off.
